history.value: A from-scratch net on a 6-mechanic generated pack holding every trigger and effect of the 6 held-out pairs (runs/2026-11-12-genpack6-40k-s1-r1-2d5163e@tsl1, seed 1) cuts their zero-shot cost 0.88 (0.02) against pack-net-scratch s1 (+5.17 -> +0.60 HP beyond parent, 675 official elite starts), against the 18-mechanic net's 0.81 (0.02) on seed 1 and the wide net's 0.98 (0.03): the transfer rides on the atoms, not the count; the 12 pairings of covered atoms neither split trained cut 0.85; training the pairing itself is worth about 1.6 HP more. What every recipe leaves: OppCard-PlainDamage on Three Sentries and a TurnEnd-Frail leak on Gremlin Nob and Lagavulin, about 0.1-0.6 HP pooled. One seed: a lead (stop rule go, 0.6 at 2 se).
